rationale: Manolo is building production-grade audio intelligence for Voice AI at ai-coustics, while Aquibur is scaling Mailmodo as a platform for embedding interactive experiences in existing channels—both are focused on making technology work reliably at scale rather than just in demos. As a CEO bootstrapping a sustainable B2B tool, Aquibur's perspective on product-led growth and modular automation could complement Manolo's work on operationalizing voice systems, and Manolo's conviction about voice becoming core infrastructure might intersect with Aquibur's interest in underutilized communication channels.
intro_message: Manolo Espinosa, meet Aquibur Rahman — you're both San Francisco founders obsessed with making emerging tech production-ready at scale, and your complementary expertise in audio/voice systems and platform automation could spark useful ideas.
